licenseAnalytics.reconDesc: These schools' licence totals disagree with their grants ledger, which means something changed their entitlement without recording it. Every figure below is understated by the difference.

licenseAnalytics.byCountryDesc: Totals are the sum of the schools listed below, so the two cannot disagree.
licenseAnalytics.bySchoolDesc: Granted is what each school was given; consumed is what it has actually spent. Both are counted from the record of every change, not from a running total.
licenseAnalytics.caveatsTitle: What these figures do and do not cover

caveat.parentPoolsNotInRevenue: Revenue covers school licences only. A parent buying for their own child has no school, so those purchases are not counted here — but the reports they generate are included in the consumed figures.
caveat.backfilledGrantsHaveNoAmount: Licences a school already held before this record began are counted as granted, not as revenue. Only one payment was ever stored per school, and it cannot be matched to a licence count that may have changed since.
caveat.unlimitedHasNoBalance: A school on an unlimited plan has no balance left to show, so it is left out of the remaining total rather than counted as having nothing left.
caveat.rewardCreditsAreNotRevenue: Reward credits are earned by contributing questions, not bought. They produce reports without revenue, and they do not reduce a school's paid balance.
